bench.note: Live throughput uses /monitor/stream snapshots while serving fixed chat requests with temperature 0, max_tokens 256, one warm-up request, then two measured runs over the same three prompts. Monitor-windowed decode tok/s is the primary live comparison.

bench.recommendation: IQ4_XS is the fastest measured fixture on this runtime at ~16.5 monitor-windowed decode tok/s, ahead of Q4_K_M at ~12.4 and ahead of the mixed-tier sub-4-bit file at ~13.0 while staying under the 4 GB working-set ceiling.

selectionVariance: The process-wide synthetic grid probe is noisy across separate server starts: in the corrected quota8 runs, Q4_K_M and UD resolved gather, while IQ4_XS resolved scalar. The GEMV bench processes all resolved gather. This report records each live run's actual startup selection rather than treating one global encoding as a fixed posture for every process. IQ2_XXS remains correctness-covered by Kernel/Parity fixtures but has no individual measurable fixture set; no speed claim is made for it beyond mixed-tier file family coverage.
